In the main Llama-3-Instruct (8B) setting, **SimPO gets a 33.8% Arena-Hard win rate and DPO gets 32.6%** (Table 4, page 6).

- **SimPO:** 33.8%, with a 95% CI of 32.0–35.9 and an average generation length of 504 tokens (Table 10, page 25).
- **DPO:** 32.6%, with a 95% CI of 30.3–34.8 and an average generation length of 528 tokens (Table 10, page 25).

The paper also reports an updated "v0.2" version of this setting. In v0.2 the preference data is labeled with a stronger reward model, ArmoRM, instead of PairRM. There, **SimPO v0.2 gets 36.5% and DPO gets 35.2%** on Arena-Hard (Table 12, page 29). The authors say SimPO v0.2 beats the earlier SimPO by 2.7 points on Arena-Hard (page 29).
